synopsis: Young Jedi Adventures: Lys and the Snowy Mountain Rescue This is a children's book tying into the animated series Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures. An all-new Little Golden Book based on the Star Wars saga!An all-new Little Golden Book based on the Star Wars saga! This Little Golden Book is based on the epic Star Wars saga. Featuring stunning retro stylized illustrations, this book includes characters from all of the Star Wars films. It is perfect for Star Wars-and Little Golden Book-fans of all ages.Star Wars has captivated millions worldwide for almost forty years.
